Efficacy and safety of ketorolac and dexamethasone for preventing renal colic post stent removal: a randomized triple-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial. This study aims to evaluate the efficacy and safety of intramuscular ketorolac and dexamethasone in preventing renal colic after stent removal.
